Emergency Tea Committee

For the harbormaster

Signing puts one coin of every eight earned from business fares in the tea tin. You may collect the tin at any time. To reach adjournment, file six motions by hand with three salt and three provisions in all.

Keep the sitting open to hear the sea answer the harbor bell, or enter the final adjournment.
